notes.title: SKIBIDI BACKROOMS v1.0 - 8 players in the lobby!
notes.content:
HELLO EVERYONE!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704197/c58d5d585a9c4d344c144387a1096dc792f04425.gif

We are pleased to announce that we are leaving early access. We settled on version 0.6 and completed all the main tasks for developing the game.
But this does not mean that we will stop developing and releasing updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704197/bb8159e0ab098a158c5e88ed0635f78f80cba3c2.png

It all depends on you, write reviews, put tags so that as many people as possible can see our game!
The larger the community and feedback, the more actively we will work on the next updates.

store.steampowered.com/app/2515210/

RELEASE v1.0


 8 players in the lobby!
 All character models have been completely redesigned.
 The sound has been improved - it should now be more spacious.
 Fix voice chat.
 Improved translation into all languages.

notes.title: UPDATE v0.2 is already available in SKIBIDI BACKROOMS!
notes.content:
Update v0.2 is already available in SKIBIDI BACKROOMS!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38872489/43d684a65f79e1b908b41308e8794ba0da2d9d09.png

Change list:


 A new location has appeared in the game - “Level 0.95”. This level is little studied and contains anomalous SKIBIDI TOILETS. Be careful and take friends with you.
 Controls redesigned - The controls in the game have been completely redesigned. It has become more comfortable, responsive and smooth. Now it will be easier for players to navigate locations and interact with objects.
 Added the ability to move objects, this mechanic is related to the new Level 0.95. Players can move objects in the game. This will allow them to create new paths and solve puzzles.
 Fixed some errors and bugs in the shadows on the levels.
 We've also introduced a new SteamAudio plugin that will immerse you more into the game's atmosphere. We are currently testing its capabilities.
 Other small improvements.

notes.title: SKIBIDI BACKROOMS - NEW MULTIPLAYER HORROR
notes.content:
Welcome everyone!

WE are pleased to announce that our new MULTIPLAYER HORROR is coming out on November 3rd. This is our best project in the last few years.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2515210/SKIBIDI_BACKROOMS/

Exciting, atmospheric and scary BACKROOMS locations await you in which you have to find a way out and not get to the SKIBIDI TOILET.

Please add the game to your wishlist to support us!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38872489/e2683009e8d1bcd95311386c13d0ad79427429fa.gif

Call your friends and expect the release in the next 2 weeks!

At the time of release on the STEAM platform, the game will be in EARLY ACCESS, so expect regular updates and improvements to the game!

The game is designed for 1-4 players.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38872489/16f7e2cace3541ff141f867f3fb4504d741ea2f2.png

We are looking forward to the release!

Rosa Special Studio.
